clue.text: Gent, a little short, beds elderly rich blonde

explanation.walkthrough: 'Gent' is the informal word for a gentleman; the elderly piece sits right in the middle of the shortened word.
explanation.definitionFit: Golden describes hair of a deep, lustrous yellow shade, so a rich blonde colour is golden.
